context.source: Account 4471-8820, consumer mobile, monthly plan advertised as including roaming in 30 listed countries. The September bill carries a roaming data charge of 62.40. The loyalty number was added after ticketing and did not pass to the flight coupon.
Retroactive credit is available within six months with a boarding pass or ticket number.
The agent can submit the claim.
zh_sentences: 预订KP2214,十八天前飞行.
忠诚度号码是在售票后添加的,并没有转移到飞行优惠券中.

经纪人可以提出索赔.

context.back_translation: Book an HR-90023, non-refundable, pay $410, stay for 9 days. Evidence of medical reasons applies. Agents can ask for abandonment of property and can issue credit, but cannot unilaterally refund.
source_sentences: Reservation HR-90023, non-refundable, 410.00 paid, check-in in nine days.
A documented medical reason applies.
The agent can request a property waiver and can issue credit but cannot refund unilaterally.
zh_sentences: 预订HR-90023,不退款,付410美元,入住时间为9天.
有证据证明的医疗原因适用.

source_sentences: Booking CE4471, non-refundable fare of 190.00, flight not taken.
Government taxes and airport charges of 44.60 are refundable on unused tickets, less a 20.00 administration fee.
The agent can process the tax refund.
zh_sentences: 预订CE4471,190.00的不可退还票价, 航班未搭乘.
政府税收和机场费用为44.60元,可退还未使用的机票,减去20.00元的管理费用.
经纪人可以处理退税.

customer_turns.zh: 我错过了预订CE4471的航班,票价为一百九十英,不退还,我接受.

title.source: Refund to a card that has since expired
title.zh: 退款到已经过期的卡
title.back_translation: Refunds to expired cards
source_sentences: Refund to a card that has since expired
zh_sentences: 退款到已经过期的卡

context.source: Booking PL2260, refund of 355.00 approved. The original card has expired and been replaced with a new number at the same bank. Refunds route to the issuer, which forwards to the successor card. The agent can explain and can pay by bank transfer if the issuer rejects it.
context.zh: 预订PL2260,355.00的退款已经批准.原始卡已过期, 已在同一银行用新号码取代.退款途径到发行人, 转发到继任者卡.经纪人可以解释,如果发行人拒绝,可以通过银行转账支付.
context.back_translation: The original card has expired and has been replaced with a new number at the same bank. The refund goes to the issuer and is forwarded to the successor card. The broker can explain that if the issuer refuses, the payment can be made by bank transfer.
source_sentences: Booking PL2260, refund of 355.00 approved.
The original card has expired and been replaced with a new number at the same bank.
Refunds route to the issuer, which forwards to the successor card.
The agent can explain and can pay by bank transfer if the issuer rejects it.
zh_sentences: 预订PL2260,355.00的退款已经批准.

customer_turns.back_translation: I started renting on March 1st, and his account seems to have remained open.
source_sentences: My tenancy started on the first of March and I opened my account that week.
His account appears to have stayed open throughout.
zh_sentences: 我在3月1日开始租房,
他的账户似乎一直保持开放.

customer_turns.source: Sort out which account is live from March and close the other one. Neither of us wants to pay twice for the same supply.
customer_turns.zh: 找出哪个账户是3月份的, 关闭另一个.我们都不想为相同的供应付出两倍的代价.
customer_turns.back_translation: Find out which account is from March, close the other. We don't want to pay twice the price for the same supply.
source_sentences: Sort out which account is live from March and close the other one.
Neither of us wants to pay twice for the same supply.
zh_sentences: 找出哪个账户是3月份的, 关闭另一个.
我们都不想为相同的供应付出两倍的代价.

resolution_space.source: Close the landlord account from the tenancy start date
resolution_space.zh: 从租开始之日起关闭房东账户
resolution_space.back_translation: Close the landlord's account from the start of the lease
source_sentences: Close the landlord account from the tenancy start date
zh_sentences: 从租开始之日起关闭房东账户

resolution_space.source: Request the tenancy agreement before adjusting either account
resolution_space.zh: 在调整任何账户之前要求租协议
resolution_space.back_translation: Request a lease agreement before adjusting any account
source_sentences: Request the tenancy agreement before adjusting either account
zh_sentences: 在调整任何账户之前要求租协议

resolution_space.source: Rebill both accounts against the correct liability dates
resolution_space.zh: 根据正确的负债日期重新计费两个账户
resolution_space.back_translation: Recharging two accounts based on the correct due date
source_sentences: Rebill both accounts against the correct liability dates
zh_sentences: 根据正确的负债日期重新计费两个账户

resolution_space.source: Escalate to the account services team
resolution_space.zh: 升级到客户服务团队
resolution_space.back_translation: Upgraded to customer service team
source_sentences: Escalate to the account services team
zh_sentences: 升级到客户服务团队

title.source: Meter serial on the bill does not match the property
title.zh: 账单上的计量器序列与财产不匹配
title.back_translation: The meter sequence on the bill doesn't match the property
source_sentences: Meter serial on the bill does not match the property
zh_sentences: 账单上的计量器序列与财产不匹配

context.source: Account UT-4433. The meter serial on the bill belongs to a neighbouring property; usage patterns suggest the two supplies were crossed at registration. The agent can raise a supply verification and cannot rebill until it completes.
context.zh: 账户UT-4433.账单上的计量器序列属于邻近的财产;使用模式表明两个供应在注册时被交叉.经纪人可以提起供应验证,并且在完成之前不能重新计费.
context.back_translation: Account UT-4433. The meter sequence on the account belongs to a neighboring property; the usage pattern indicates that the two supplies were crossed at the time of registration. The broker can raise a proof of supply and cannot re-bill until it is completed.
source_sentences: Account UT-4433.
The meter serial on the bill belongs to a neighbouring property; usage patterns suggest the two supplies were crossed at registration.
The agent can raise a supply verification and cannot rebill until it completes.
zh_sentences: 账户UT-4433.
账单上的计量器序列属于邻近的财产;使用模式表明两个供应在注册时被交叉.
经纪人可以提起供应验证,并且在完成之前不能重新计费.

customer_turns.source: The meter serial number printed on my bill for account UT-4433 does not match the meter in my cupboard. The numbers are completely different.
customer_turns.zh: 在我的账单上印有UT-4433的计量器序列号与我的柜子里的计量器不匹配.这些数字完全不同.
customer_turns.back_translation: The serial number of the meter stamped UT-4433 on my bill does not match the meter in my locker. The numbers are completely different.
source_sentences: The meter serial number printed on my bill for account UT-4433 does not match the meter in my cupboard.
The numbers are completely different.
zh_sentences: 在我的账单上印有UT-4433的计量器序列号与我的柜子里的计量器不匹配.
这些数字完全不同.

customer_turns.source: My neighbour mentioned her bills look unusually low, and mine have looked far too high since we both moved in two years ago.
customer_turns.zh: 我的邻居说她的账单看起来不寻常的低, 和我的看起来太高了自从我们两年前搬进来以来.
customer_turns.back_translation: My neighbor says her bill looks unusually low, and mine looks too high since we moved in two years ago.
source_sentences: My neighbour mentioned her bills look unusually low, and mine have looked far too high since we both moved in two years ago.
zh_sentences: 我的邻居说她的账单看起来不寻常的低, 和我的看起来太高了自从我们两年前搬进来以来.

customer_turns.source: Check whether our supplies have been crossed. Tell me what happens to the bills either of us has already paid over those years.
customer_turns.zh: 检查我们的供应是否已经交叉.告诉我这些年来我们已经付出的账单会怎么样.
customer_turns.back_translation: Check if our supplies have crossed.Tell me what will happen to the bills we have paid over the years.
source_sentences: Check whether our supplies have been crossed.
Tell me what happens to the bills either of us has already paid over those years.
zh_sentences: 检查我们的供应是否已经交叉.
告诉我这些年来我们已经付出的账单会怎么样.

resolution_space.source: Raise a supply verification visit for both properties
resolution_space.zh: 对两个物业进行供应验证访问
resolution_space.back_translation: Supply verification visits to two properties
source_sentences: Raise a supply verification visit for both properties
zh_sentences: 对两个物业进行供应验证访问

resolution_space.source: Suspend billing pending the verification outcome
resolution_space.zh: 在等待验证结果时暂停计费
resolution_space.back_translation: Suspend billing while waiting for verification results
source_sentences: Suspend billing pending the verification outcome
zh_sentences: 在等待验证结果时暂停计费

resolution_space.source: Correct the meter serial on the account record
resolution_space.zh: 纠正账户记录中的计量器序列
resolution_space.back_translation: Sequence of meters corrected in account records
source_sentences: Correct the meter serial on the account record
zh_sentences: 纠正账户记录中的计量器序列

resolution_space.source: Escalate to the metering team
resolution_space.zh: 升级到计量团队
resolution_space.back_translation: Upgraded to Measurement Team
source_sentences: Escalate to the metering team
zh_sentences: 升级到计量团队

title.source: Tariff change blocked by an outstanding balance
title.zh: 关税变更被未偿还的余额所阻碍
title.back_translation: Tariff changes hampered by unpaid balances
source_sentences: Tariff change blocked by an outstanding balance
zh_sentences: 关税变更被未偿还的余额所阻碍

context.source: Account UT-7051 carries an arrears balance of 280.00, which blocks a tariff change under the credit rules. A payment plan clearing the arrears within twelve months restores eligibility. The agent can set up the plan and apply the tariff on its first payment.
context.zh: 账户UT-7051的拖欠余额为280.00,这阻止了根据信贷规则的关税变化.在12个月内清理滞欠款的支付计划恢复了资格.经纪人可以建立计划,并在第一次付款时应用关税.
context.back_translation: The overdue balance on account UT-7051 was 280.00, which prevented a tariff change under the credit rules. Payment plans that cleared arrears within 12 months were re-qualified. Brokers could establish plans and apply tariffs on the first payment.
source_sentences: Account UT-7051 carries an arrears balance of 280.00, which blocks a tariff change under the credit rules.
A payment plan clearing the arrears within twelve months restores eligibility.
The agent can set up the plan and apply the tariff on its first payment.
zh_sentences: 账户UT-7051的拖欠余额为280.00,这阻止了根据信贷规则的关税变化.
在12个月内清理滞欠款的支付计划恢复了资格.
经纪人可以建立计划,并在第一次付款时应用关税.

customer_turns.source: I am trying to move to your cheaper fixed tariff on account UT-7051 and the website will not let me. It gives no reason at all.
customer_turns.zh: 我试图转移到您的更便宜的固定费用账户UT-7051和网站不会让我.没有任何理由.
customer_turns.back_translation: I tried to transfer to your cheaper fixed fee account UT-7051 and the site won't let me.
source_sentences: I am trying to move to your cheaper fixed tariff on account UT-7051 and the website will not let me.
It gives no reason at all.
zh_sentences: 我试图转移到您的更便宜的固定费用账户UT-7051和网站不会让我.
没有任何理由.

customer_turns.source: I do owe about two hundred and eighty pounds from the winter, which I have been paying off a bit at a time when I can.
customer_turns.zh: 我确实欠约二百八十英从冬天,我已经支付一点一点的时候我可以.
customer_turns.back_translation: I do owe about two hundred and eighty pounds from the winter, which I have to pay little by little when I can.
source_sentences: I do owe about two hundred and eighty pounds from the winter, which I have been paying off a bit at a time when I can.
zh_sentences: 我确实欠约二百八十英从冬天,我已经支付一点一点的时候我可以.

customer_turns.source: Tell me whether the balance is the reason and what I must do to qualify. I want the cheaper rate as soon as possible.
customer_turns.zh: 告诉我,平衡是否是原因,我必须做些什么才能有资格.我希望尽快获得更便宜的价格.
customer_turns.back_translation: Tell me if the balance is the reason and what I have to do to qualify.I hope to get the cheaper price as soon as possible.
source_sentences: Tell me whether the balance is the reason and what I must do to qualify.
I want the cheaper rate as soon as possible.
zh_sentences: 告诉我,平衡是否是原因,我必须做些什么才能有资格.
我希望尽快获得更便宜的价格.

resolution_space.source: Set up a payment plan and apply the tariff at its first payment
resolution_space.zh: 建立支付计划,并在首次支付时实施关税
resolution_space.back_translation: Establish payment plans and implement tariffs at the time of the first payment
source_sentences: Set up a payment plan and apply the tariff at its first payment
zh_sentences: 建立支付计划,并在首次支付时实施关税

resolution_space.source: Apply the tariff immediately with the arrears carried over
resolution_space.zh: 立即适用关税,并将拖欠的债务转移
resolution_space.back_translation: Immediate application of duties and transfer of arrears
source_sentences: Apply the tariff immediately with the arrears carried over
zh_sentences: 立即适用关税,并将拖欠的债务转移

resolution_space.source: Explain the credit rule and decline the change for now
resolution_space.zh: 解释信用规则并暂时拒绝更改
resolution_space.back_translation: Explaining the credit rules and temporarily rejecting changes
source_sentences: Explain the credit rule and decline the change for now
zh_sentences: 解释信用规则并暂时拒绝更改

resolution_space.zh: 升级到客户支持团队
